Name: Publish even if nothing changed
Description: Upload even when the packed addon is byte for byte the one published last time, and even if the last publish was minutes ago. Everything else about publishing is set per map, in the Workshop window.
Warning: Every subscriber and every server redownloads the addon for an update that contains nothing new.

Name: Publish to an item that is not a map
Description: Publish even when Steam lists the bound item as something other than a map - a content pack, a weapon pack - which is otherwise refused. Only for an item that really is meant to become this map. An item that belongs to another game is still refused.
Warning: The item's current contents are replaced by this map for everyone subscribed to it and every server that mounts it.

Name: Do not look the item up first
Description: Skip asking Steam's public API what the item being updated actually is. The lookup needs no account and no key. It is what puts the name of the map you are about to replace in the log, and what refuses to publish over an item that is not a map.
Warning: Without it, a wrong item - another game's, or one that is not a map - is only discovered after the upload.

Name: Keep the staging folder
Description: Leave the temporary folder that was packed, so you can see exactly which files went into the addon.
